aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab makes software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection times and fewer repeated questions. Founder — Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We make practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering: it helps them take online orders, manage collection times, keep a steady flow of orders and spend less time on the same questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a permanent address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a food truck easier with tools built around how such a business really works.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie — a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their area — I learned more about the difficulties mobile food businesses face. Unlike ordinary restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers see only the pickup times your kitchen can really manage. The system takes into account each dish’s preparation time and how many portions you prepare at once.

comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, via Apple Pay or Google Pay, or at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported yet.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year — ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Customers can order ahead for a future date or time before the event starts.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand one out, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen for customers with order numbers and whether they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map and nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place: food hygiene documents, insurance, gas equipment check. We remind you before they expire, and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one leads straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with separate prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to work with HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Say how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital loyalty stamp cards — stamps are added and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into combos and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as WhatsApp auto-replies, but for questions on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Several screens — at the window and in the kitchen — show the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online orders pause so customers don’t place an order you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you take orders without signal; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card prepayment via Stripe when customers order online.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an order deadline for items that need to be prepared in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that are not shown on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see how much you really earned at each event, not just your takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatic SMS to customers when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as “Sold out” with one tap — it becomes inactive for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Enter a quantity and it goes down with every order, then the item automatically becomes “Sold out”.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone — no separate payment terminal needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time (a time slot), and the load is spread across the whole shift.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck’s window, payment on your own payment terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: WhatsApp auto-replies to questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems are designed for a permanent address, stable Wi-Fi and the same schedule every week. But you are in a new place every week, at different times, with weak mobile signal or none at all. HatchGrab was created exactly for this.

landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.

landing.does.title: Created for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” While you drive to your spot or stand at the grill, WhatsApp messages get answered from your menu and schedule. Coming soon — Messenger and Instagram.
